extraction.summary_en: This filing is a complementary report by the commissaire aux avantages particuliers (CAC), dated 22 July 2008, prepared under a court order of 14 May 2008, assessing the nature and value of the preferential rights attached to proposed new preference-share classes "A", "B" and "B'" that ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES intended to create via an Extraordinary General Meeting. The report describes the rights (priority dividend, mandatory/optional conversion, information/audit rights, board seats, liquidation preference) but does not itself record the AGE's decision or its realisation; it mentions in passing that 150,861 "B" shares were to be issued at a subscription price of €5.80, but no full capital-before/after figures or shareholder list are given.

events.date_basis: Report dated 22 July 2008, describing an operation to be decided by an AGE not shown in this filing (mission ordered 14 May 2008, per 'l'Assemblée Générale Extraordinaire destinée à créer lesdites actions').
events.mechanism: Actions de préférence 'A' avec dividende prioritaire (plafond 35 000€/an, cumul 245 000€) et conversion obligatoire en actions ordinaires (cotation, cession totale, ou décision unanime/2015)

evidence.quote_fr: Cette opération consiste en la création d'actions de préférence dites de catégorie « A » et de catégorie « B » et « B' », bénéficiant des droits particuliers suivants : ... I.1. Actions de catégorie A

events.gloss_en: CAC report on the proposed creation of preference share class 'A' with priority dividend and mandatory conversion terms.
events.notes: This document is the CAC's assessment report, not the AGE minutes; it does not itself state that the creation was completed.

events.date_basis: Report dated 22 July 2008, describing an operation to be decided by an AGE not shown in this filing.
events.mechanism: Actions de préférence 'B' (information renforcée, audits, sièges au Comité de Suivi, liquidation préférentielle, conversion en ordinaires ou en 'B'' selon anti-dilution) ; 'B'' résultant de la conversion de 'B'

evidence.quote_fr: Cette opération consiste en la création d'actions de préférence dites de catégorie « A » et de catégorie « B » et « B' »... I.2. Actions de catégorie B et B' ... «N° » désigne le nombre d'actions « B» émises en vertu des présentes résolutions, soit 150.861 actions ... « P » est le prix de souscription des actions « B », soit 5,80 euros

events.gloss_en: CAC report on the proposed creation of preference share classes 'B' and 'B'' with enhanced investor rights and anti-dilution conversion mechanism; mentions 150,861 'B' shares at €5.80 per share.
events.notes: The reference to '150.861 actions' 'émises en vertu des présentes résolutions' suggests an associated capital increase reserved to holders of class B shares, but this report does not give capital-before/after figures or confirm realisation; treated as authorisation_only pending the AGE minutes.

issues: The filing is only the CAC's complementary report on avantages particuliers (art. L.225-147); the actual AGE resolutions creating the preference shares are not included, so it is unclear from this document alone whether the creation/capital increase was ultimately adopted and realised.

The report references '150.861 actions «B» émises en vertu des présentes résolutions' at a subscription price of 5,80 euros, implying an associated capital increase, but no nominal amount, capital_before/after, or full shareholder list is given in this document.
Letterhead states capital of 200 000 euros (p1.15) but per instructions this is not used to create a snapshot since it is not printed as a capital-composition statement/table.
